headline: SKYWARD learns to hum — and to draw its own front door
lede: The flight school's motor gets a real two-saw voice with a load-opened filter, the glider gets wind where it had dead silence, crashes cut before they crash, and phone players finally get the whole sky: the canvas was silently collapsing to a strip at every screen size, and the attract vista had literally never been drawn — both fixed and pinned.

notes.text: Rich engine: two saws detuned ±9 cents through a filter that opens with throttle; the 13 Hz prop wobble now bends pitch as well as volume.
New pure law windBed: the glider's rush rises with airspeed and ducks under rain — motorless honesty kept, dead-mixer silence gone.
The stage's inline position:relative overrode its absolute inset-0 — the canvas rendered at the wrong aspect at every size. Found by the 390px audit; prod masked it via a lucky first-resize bake.
Attract had never called render: every load showed an empty canvas behind the title. The vista now orbits live.
48/48 mutants, 9 new pins, and a permanent 390×844 HUD-overlap audit in skywardplay that counts the corner chrome.
